did: Home's half of the Renders redesign. The Renders page now lists previews, waiting, done for their one day, or failed, each naming its template so the phone can link to it, and saying why one failed. A render in progress now says which station it is at and which scene of how many, from the recorder's own count, never its words, and home's render image moved to the recorder that prints those counts.

calls.title: A preview past its deadline shows as failed by home
options: Failed, by home, with reason overdue
Add a new failure kind the phone does not know
calls.why: Older phones read only recorder or home, so a new kind would break them; overdue rides in the optional reason field instead. Codex then found that a video landing after the deadline must still read failed, matching the template's own page.
calls.undo: Ask for a distinct failure kind once every phone reads it; feeds::renders previews_lived sets it.

calls.title: Scene progress comes from the recorder's own output lines
options: The worker counts the recorder's count lines into job.progress
The recorder writes its own progress file
calls.why: The recorder is one process, so only it knows its scenes. Reading its lines kept some-ui's change to two print statements and left the worker the one writer of the lane folder. Until home runs the new recorder, the phone shows the scene with no total.
calls.undo: Have the recorder write a progress file and point feeds::renders at it; render-calls.sh's progress() goes.

left: Clip walks and shorts print no scene lines, so they have no progress; nothing asked for it.
An essay week the videos list hides (withdrawn, or held by two) can still show on the board, and its link reaches an episode page that doesn't list it; rare, and left as it was.
